question: Who among the following had written the ‘Kamayani’ ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jaishankar Prasad.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __**Kamayani:**__

__
 
• Kamayani is a **Hindi poem by Jaishankar Prasad.**
 
• It is **one of the greatest literary works written** in modern times in Hindi literature.
 
• It **signifies the epitome of Chhayavadi school of Hindi poetry which gained popularity in the late 19th and early 20th centuries.**
 
• The poem is based on a Vedic story about Manu, a man who survives a deluge and becomes emotionless.
 
• The **poem uses mythological metaphors to depict the interplay of human emotions, thoughts, and actions. **
 
• **Kamayani is considered the epitome of the Chhayavadi school of Hindi poetr**y, which was popular in the late 19th and early 20th centuries.
